budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Each skipper must touch its assigned buoy and then its distinct dock. Skippers receive own progress/arrival rewards and compete for the first-arrival bonus while towing can help a partner.
task.natural_termination: All three boats have arrived. A moored boat remains a stationary physical obstacle and has only action 0. Otherwise the time bound is 80 raw transitions.
task.interaction: A raised sail casts a length-two downwind shadow with crosswind width one, preventing nearby high-sail movement. Low sails row at a stamina cost. Voluntary low-sail recipients can be pulled into a helper old cell; the helper loses any second movement cell and one stamina. Occupancy, islands, buoy access and first-arrival timing create additional coupling.
task.observation_access: The terrain, buoy/dock locations, wind and clock are public. Another boat is visible exactly within Manhattan distance 3; its displayed attributes are present in the masked peer record. Own goal, sail, stamina and route state are always available. Tow entities are visible only when both endpoints are visible. Invisible data are zero with an explicit visibility bit; no privileged full state is a policy input.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Arrived at assigned dock on this transition
Reached required buoy on this transition
Helper moved and pulled a recipient on this transition
Raised-sail movement attempt stalled in a wind shadow

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
